recentItems.title: Little Dieter Needs To Fly | FULL MOVIE | Werner Herzog | Vietnam War Biography Documentary
recentItems.description:
LITTLE DIETER NEEDS TO FLY | Werner Herzog, Dieter Dengler | Vietnam War, Biography, Documentary, Arthouse https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBrrfZs-ew7P0N9nUwg_mdvgfMP37hXJr

In 1966, Dieter Dengler was shot down over Laos, captured, and, down to 85 pounds, escaped. Barefoot, surviving monsoons, leeches, and machete-wielding villagers, he was rescued. Now, near 60, living on Mt. Tamalpais, Dengler tells his story: a German lad surviving Allied bombings in World War II, postwar poverty, apprenticed to a smith, beaten regularly. At 18, he emigrates and peels potatoes in the U.S. Air Force. He leaves for California and college, then enlistment in the Navy to learn to fly. A quiet man of sorrows tells his story: war, capture, harrowing conditions, escape, and miraculous rescue. Where did he find the strength; how does he now live with his memories? Directed by Werner Herzog, Little Dieter Needs To Fly features Dieter Dengler and Eugene Deatrick.

recentItems.title: Peking Opera Blues | FULL MOVIE | Tsui Hark | Action Comedy
recentItems.description:
PEKING OPERA BLUES | Tsui Hark | Action, Comedy, Period Film https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBrrfZs-ew7PDeUmZnKLErFZF-_wyeDn4

The movie is set in chaotic 1920's China, when warlords fought each other for power while Sun Yat-Sen's underground movement tried to establish a democratic republic. The movie tells the story of three young women and two young men who are thrown together. One young woman grabs a box of jewels during the looting when one warlord takes Peking. A deserting soldier joins her, but the jewels end up at the Peking Opera. Here we meet the daughter of the head of the troupe, who dreams of being an actress. But even female roles are played by men in the opera. Soon, the daughter of the currently ruling warlord and a male agent of the democratic underground are involved. Peking Opera Blues stars Brigitte Lin, Sally Yeh, Cherie Chung, Mark Cheng, Kwok-Keung Cheung, Wu Ma, and Kenneth Tsang, and is directed by Tsui Hark.
